set.gloss: pool (shared group or resource, esp. press pool; of staff, players, funds)

example.el: Μόνο το πουλ των δημοσιογράφων είχε πρόσβαση στη συνάντηση.
example.en: Only the press pool had access to the meeting.

why: 'πουλ αυτοκινήτων' (car pool) is unnatural; main Greek use is press/staff pool
inflected (ancient aorist) form of γίγνομαι used only in frozen phrases; not a headword
